size.name: Your vehicle
size.title: How big is it?
size.why: Two numbers, and most of the setup fills itself in from them.

frame.name: Motor layout
frame.title: How do the motors sit?
frame.why: Wrong here is the most common reason a new multirotor flips on its first take-off.

frameHeli.name: Helicopter
frameHeli.title: Your helicopter
frameHeli.why: Heli firmware already knows it is a helicopter. This sets up what is shared with every vehicle; rotor setup is in Heli setup.

orient.name: Board orientation
orient.title: Which way is the board mounted?
orient.why: So the board knows which way is forward.

radio.name: Receiver
radio.title: Connect your receiver
radio.why: A receiver on a serial port is not found on its own. Tell ArduDeck where it is plugged in.

compass.name: Compass
compass.title: Which compass should it use?
compass.why: The one on the GPS mast is away from motor currents and usually the better one.

modes.name: Flight modes
modes.title: What does the mode switch do?
modes.why: Three positions, three modes. Pick one per position.

motors.name: Motors
motors.title: Check the motors
motors.why: One motor at a time. Answer what you see.

battery.name: Battery and failsafes
battery.title: Battery and what happens when things go wrong
battery.why: Warnings at the right voltage, and a plan for low battery and a lost signal.

ready.name: Ready to arm
ready.title: Ready to arm?
ready.why: What the flight controller itself says is still in the way.

psize.name: Your plane
psize.title: Measure the wing
psize.why: A ruler and a kitchen scale are enough. ArduDeck works out the stall speed, and the airspeed limits come from that.

power.name: Power
power.title: What makes it go?
power.why: Decides the throttle outputs and whether there is a motor check at all.

extras.name: Extras
extras.title: Anything else on the plane?
extras.why: Flaps, airbrakes, steerable wheel, retracts: each needs an output.

launch.name: Take-off
launch.title: How does it take off?
launch.why: Decides when the motor is allowed to start.

soar.name: Soaring
soar.title: Should it use thermals?
soar.why: ArduPilot can circle in rising air to stay up longer.

airframe.name: Airframe
airframe.title: What kind of plane is it?
airframe.why: Decides which outputs drive which surfaces.

wingTail.name: Wing and tail
wingTail.title: What do the wing and tail look like?
wingTail.why: The plane half of the VTOL: decides which outputs drive which surfaces.

wingTailsitter.title: How does it steer in plane flight?
wingTailsitter.why: A tailsitter flies on its wing; the question is what moves the air.

outputs.name: Outputs
outputs.title: What is plugged into each output?
outputs.why: Servos and ESC on the outputs ArduPilot expects for this airframe.

surfaces.name: Control surfaces
surfaces.title: Do the surfaces move the right way?
surfaces.why: Checked in FBWA, where the board stabilises. A surface fighting the wrong way crashes on launch.

thrcheck.name: Motor
thrcheck.title: Check the motor
thrcheck.why: Prop off. Throttle up a little: it must spin, and stop at zero.

airspeed.name: Airspeed sensor
airspeed.title: Is there an airspeed sensor?
airspeed.why: Optional. Without one ArduPilot estimates airspeed from GPS and throttle.

vtype.name: VTOL type
vtype.title: How does it hover?
vtype.why: The firmware says plane; this tells it how the lift motors work.

vframe.name: Lift motor layout
vframe.title: How do the lift motors sit?
vframe.why: Same layouts as a copter: 3, 4, 6 or 8 motors. Only the outputs differ.

assist.name: VTOL assist
assist.title: Should the lift motors help in plane flight?
assist.why: Q_ASSIST_SPEED. A wrong value is a common pre-arm failure.

drive.name: Steering
drive.title: How does it steer?
drive.why: Decides what output 1 and output 3 do.

drivetest.name: Motor and steering test
drivetest.title: Check the wheels
drivetest.why: Wheels off the ground. Answer what you see.

drivetestBoat.title: Check the motor and rudder
drivetestBoat.why: On a stand or in shallow water. Answer what you see.

motordrv.name: Motor driver
motordrv.title: What drives the motor?
motordrv.why: ESC, or a brushed motor driver. Decides the output type and the dead zone.

windvane.name: Wind vane
windvane.title: How does it sense the wind?
windvane.why: A sailboat needs wind direction to sail on its own.

water.name: Depth sensor
water.title: Fresh or salt water?
water.why: Depth is worked out from pressure, which depends on the water.

leak.name: Leak sensor
leak.title: Where is the leak sensor?
leak.why: So it surfaces before the electronics drown.

subframe.name: Thruster layout
subframe.title: Which frame is it?
subframe.why: Picks how the thrusters are mixed.

thrusters.name: Thruster directions
thrusters.title: Do the thrusters push the right way?
thrusters.why: Props and wiring decide it; ArduSub can detect and fix it in the water.

joystick.name: Control
joystick.title: How will you drive it?
joystick.why: Subs are usually driven with a gamepad through the tether, not a radio.

reason.acroYaw: Yaw rate in Acro, from the yaw acceleration limit for {{prop}} in props
reason.accel: Roll and pitch acceleration limit for {{prop}} in props
reason.accelYaw: Yaw acceleration limit for {{prop}} in props
reason.rateFilter: Rate controller filter, half the gyro filter ({{hz}} Hz)
reason.rateFilterOff: Filter off, as Mission Planner sets it
reason.gyroFilter: Gyro filter {{hz}} Hz for {{prop}} in props
reason.hover: Starting hover throttle; learned in flight
reason.motVoltMax: Full battery voltage for motor scaling, {{cells}} cells
reason.motVoltMin: Empty battery voltage for motor scaling, {{cells}} cells
reason.battLow: Low battery warning at {{volts}} V ({{cells}} cells)

role.triYawServo: Yaw tilt servo of the rear motor

test.aileron: Stick right: right aileron goes up, left goes down
test.aileronLeft: Stick right: left aileron goes down
test.aileronRight: Stick right: right aileron goes up
test.vtailPitch: Stick back: both surfaces go up
test.elevonRoll: Stick right: left elevon goes down
test.flaperonLeft: Stick right: left goes down; flap switch: both go down
test.flaps: Flap switch down: flaps go down

wing.label: Flying wing with elevons
wing.hint: the usual tailsitter: elevons do pitch and roll in plane flight

twin.label: Two motors
twin.hint: one per wing, steers with thrust too

flaperon.label: Flaperons
flaperon.hint: ailerons that also act as flaps

bungee.label: Bungee
bungee.hint: long delay so the prop clears the cord

tdrag.label: Runway, tail-dragger
tdrag.hint: holds the tail down at first

none.label: No sensor
none.hint: airspeed estimated from GPS and throttle

quad.label: Quadplane
quad.hint: separate lift motors, the most common

tilt.label: Tilt-rotor
tilt.hint: motors tilt forward for plane flight

tail.label: Tailsitter
tail.hint: takes off standing on its tail

steer.label: Steering servo + motor
steer.hint: like an RC car: front wheels turn

skid.label: Skid steering
skid.hint: left and right side driven, like a tank

omni.label: Omni or mecanum
omni.hint: 3 or 4 wheels that drive sideways too

sail.label: Sailboat
sail.hint: sail winch, wing sail or rotating mast

esc.label: ESC with forward and reverse
esc.hint: set the ESC to forward and reverse, idle at 1500

relay.label: Brushed, with a direction pin
relay.hint: L298N and similar: PWM plus a relay pin

none.label: No vane yet
none.hint: cannot sail on its own without one

auto.label: Detect for me
auto.hint: ArduSub motor detect, about a minute in the water

manual.label: One by one
manual.hint: spin each thruster and reverse the ones that push the wrong way

pad.label: Gamepad through the tether
pad.hint: the usual way: buttons for modes, arm, lights

rc.label: RC radio
rc.hint: needs a tethered buoy for the antenna

airframe.three: Writes RUDDER_ONLY = 1: the roll stick steers with the rudder. Automatic ground steering is off on these.
airframe.invv: Same outputs as a V-tail; the directions are usually the other way round, which the surface check catches.

airframeTail.none: Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE = 2: the motors do all the steering, in hover and in plane flight.

power.twin: The two motors also help yaw by differential thrust (RUDD_DT_GAIN).
power.icWarn: A kill switch on the radio is required before the engine can be started. ArduDeck writes ICE_ENABLE = 1; the engine settings appear after a restart.
power.gliderWarn: No motor: the motor check is skipped and thermal soaring is offered. ArduPilot has no dedicated pure-glider page, so treat this path as unverified.

extras.all: Pick everything this plane has, or nothing. Each one gets its own output and shows up in the surface check.

launch.hand: The motor will not start in a hand launch while the nose is above 40° or the wings past 30°. A pusher prop with no delay can start in your hand: the delay prevents it.
launch.bungee: The motor will not start in a hand launch while the nose is above 40° or the wings past 30°. A pusher prop with no delay can start in your hand: the delay prevents it.
launch.belly: The motor will not start in a hand launch while the nose is above 40° or the wings past 30°. A pusher prop with no delay can start in your hand: the delay prevents it.

soar.yes: Soaring needs an airspeed sensor. TECS_SPDWEIGHT = 2 is written with it; the altitude limits (SOAR_ALT_MIN, SOAR_ALT_CUTOFF, SOAR_ALT_MAX) appear after the restart.

airspeed.i2c: Written for an MS4525. A DLVR or another sensor needs its own ARSPD_TYPE. Calibrate the zero offset on the ground with the tube covered.
airspeed.can: Calibrate the zero offset on the ground with the tube covered.

vtype.quad: Q_ENABLE = 1 needs a restart: the Q_ parameters only exist after it.
vtype.tilt: Q_ENABLE = 1 needs a restart: the Q_ parameters only exist after it. Q_TILT_ENABLE is written after the restart.
vtype.tail: Q_ENABLE = 1 needs a restart: the Q_ parameters only exist after it. The tailsitter settings are written after the restart.

assist.offWarn: Since Plane 4.2, 0 no longer turns it off: it means assist during transitions only and fails pre-arm checks. Off is -1.
assist.onWarn: Since Plane 4.2, 0 no longer turns it off: it means assist during transitions only and fails pre-arm checks. Off is -1.

driveRover.balance: Balance bots also need wheel encoders. Learn the cruise speed and throttle on the first drive.

driveBoat.vector: Set MOT_VEC_ANGLEMAX to the motor deflection at full steering in Parameters.
driveBoat.sail: SAIL_ENABLE = 1 needs a restart. Then put the sail on a free output: function 89 main sail, 128 wing sail or 137 mast rotation. The wind vane is the next step.

motordrv.esc: Servos must not share an output group with brushed motor outputs. Restart after changing the motor type. Raise the throttle slowly on the first drive and store where the wheels start as MOT_THR_MIN.
motordrv.relay: Servos must not share an output group with brushed motor outputs. Restart after changing the motor type. Raise the throttle slowly on the first drive and store where the wheels start as MOT_THR_MIN.
motordrv.bipolar: Servos must not share an output group with brushed motor outputs. Restart after changing the motor type. Raise the throttle slowly on the first drive and store where the wheels start as MOT_THR_MIN.

windvane.nmea: Mount it high, clear of the sail. Calibrate its direction once it reads.
windvane.analog: Mount it high, clear of the sail. Calibrate its direction once it reads.
windvane.noneWarn: Without a wind vane a sailboat cannot sail on its own.

subframe.4: Frames missing an axis rely on weight and buoyancy to stay stable in that axis.
subframe.5: Frames missing an axis rely on weight and buoyancy to stay stable in that axis.
subframe.6: Frames missing an axis rely on weight and buoyancy to stay stable in that axis.
subframe.7Warn: Custom needs firmware that knows your layout: the thruster mix is compiled in, not set by parameters. With such a build flashed, carry on from the thruster check.

leak.nav: Touch the probe with a wet finger: the leak alarm must fire.
leak.aux: Touch the probe with a wet finger: the leak alarm must fire.
leak.noneWarn: Without a leak sensor the sub cannot surface on its own when water gets in.

joystick.pad: The gamepad buttons use the ArduSub defaults: 1 Manual, 2 Depth Hold, 3 Stabilize, 4 disarm, 6 arm. Change them in Cockpit or in the joystick setup.
joystick.rcWarn: RC does not reach through water: the receiver needs a tethered buoy.

check.surfaces: Put it in FBWA, props off. Never swap plugs or reverse on the transmitter: flip Reversed here.
check.surfacesMixed: Mixed surfaces: if only one axis is wrong, the left and right functions are swapped (swap them in Outputs). If both axes are wrong, flip Reversed.
check.thrcheck: Prop off. A plain PWM ESC may need the one-time throttle range calibration first.
check.thrcheckIc: Never reach near the prop between automatic restart attempts.
check.drivetest: Wheels off the ground, throttle 20%. Wrong way: flip Reversed on that output in Outputs, do not swap plugs. If the motor test says the command was rejected, the receiver step is not done yet.
check.drivetestBoat: On a stand or in shallow water, prop clear of hands. Wrong way: flip Reversed on that output.
check.thrusters: Auto detect only fixes thrusters that roll, pitch or yaw the sub. Never run thrusters in air longer than 30 s. Sets MOT_n_DIRECTION.
check.water: Zero the depth at the surface before every dive: Calibration, Barometer.

wizard.title: Set up a new vehicle
wizard.reviewNote: Changes are shown for review before they are written
wizard.cancelled: Nothing was written: the review was cancelled.
wizard.writeFailed: Some parameters could not be written.
wizard.restartNeeded: This only takes effect after the flight controller restarts.
wizard.restartFor: These settings appear after a restart: {{params}}
wizard.restartFailed: The flight controller did not accept the restart.
wizard.notBack: The flight controller did not come back after the restart.
wizard.stillMissing: Still missing after the restart: {{params}}. This firmware may not have them.
wizard.noVehicle: Connect an ArduPilot vehicle and load its parameters to start.

size.frameNote: the size printed on most frames
size.propNote: first number on the prop, 10x4.5 is 10
size.cellsNote: read from the battery voltage, change it if wrong
size.overlap: {{prop}} in props are too big for a {{mm}} mm frame: they would hit each other.
size.toScale: To scale: {{mm}} mm motor to motor, {{prop}} in props.

firmware.title: Heli firmware
firmware.text: Helicopters run the separate heli firmware; FRAME_CLASS comes preset.

wizard.title: This wizard
wizard.text: Board orientation, receiver, compass, modes and battery: the steps every vehicle shares.

heliSetup.title: Rotor setup
heliSetup.text: Swashplate, collective, rotor speed (RSC) and tail type stay in the Heli setup.

interlock.title: Motor interlock
interlock.text: A motor interlock switch is required to arm (RC8_OPTION 32 by default).

dual.label: Two motors
dual.hint: one each side of the wing, steered by speed difference

copter.label: Copter-style
copter.hint: 3 or more motors, like a quad on its tail

wizard.noPicture: No motor picture for this frame.

frameNote.single: Outputs 1 to 4 drive the flaps (front, right, back, left), output 5 the motor. There is no motor order test: check the flaps armed in Stabilize, props off.
frameNote.coax: Outputs 1 to 4 drive the flaps, 5 and 6 the upper (CCW) and lower (CW) motor. There is no motor order test: check the flaps armed in Stabilize, props off.
frameNote.bi: Motors on functions 73 / 74, tilt servos on 75 / 76. ArduPilot does not document default outputs: check them in Outputs.
frameNote.tri: The rear motor sits on a yaw servo on output 7. Set SERVO7_TRIM where the tail does not turn; MOT_YAW_SV_ANGLE limits the tilt.
frameNote.stacked: Coaxial pairs sit on top of each other. The motor test spins the top motor before the bottom one: watch which one turns.

wizard.tiltMaskOther: Set Q_TILT_MASK to the tilting motors in Parameters.
wizard.vframeNote: The motor test after this uses this picture, same as for a copter. Plane surfaces keep outputs 1 to 4.
wizard.vframeNoteTail: No motor picture for one or two motors: the left and right motors are checked here.

two.label: Two outputs
two.hint: one per servo: each can be trimmed and reversed alone

wizard.outputsNote: ArduPilot defaults first, extras on the next free outputs. Change one only if your wiring differs; the surface check catches mistakes.
wizard.outputsNoteVtol: Lift motors use 4 + motor number and are set by Q_ENABLE. Extras skip those outputs.

stab.title: Stabilise check
stab.text: Tilt the plane right: the ailerons fight it

motorL.title: Left motor
motorL.text: Throttle up a little: the left motor spins

start.title: Start
start.text: Starter runs, then the engine idles

spin.title: Spin
spin.text: Throttle up a little: the motor spins

balance.title: Balance
balance.text: Wheels off, pitch it forward by hand in Manual: the wheels drive forward

omni.title: Each motor
omni.text: Spins the wheel shown in the layout, forward

sail.title: Sail
sail.text: Throttle stick down sheets the sail in

rudder.title: Rudder
rudder.text: Stick right: the boat would turn right

inWater.title: In the water
inWater.text: Neutral or slightly positive buoyancy, calm water

psize.massNote: with battery, on a kitchen scale
psize.own: Your own value. The estimate would be {{estimate}} m/s.
psize.from: From {{area}} dm² of wing carrying {{mass}} g.
psize.note: Plane 4.5 renamed these: older firmware gets ARSPD_FBW_MIN, TRIM_ARSPD_CM and ARSPD_FBW_MAX instead. ArduDeck writes whichever names the board has.

battery.note: Voltages from Mission Planner initial parameters. Calibrate the voltage and current readings in the Battery tab with a multimeter.

ready.none: Nothing in the way. It will arm.
ready.noneSub: Put the props on, stand back, and arm.
ready.sub: Fix them in any order. This list updates as soon as the flight controller agrees.

rx.waiting: No receiver signal yet. Switch the radio on.

wizard.subModes: Subs change modes with gamepad buttons, not a switch. ArduSub defaults: 1 Manual, 2 Depth Hold, 3 Stabilize. Change them in Cockpit or in the joystick setup.
